finalText:
All 625 tests pass now.

The bug was in `orderTotal` (`src/pricing.js:39-43`): tax was computed on the original pre-discount `cents` instead of the discounted amount, even though the function's own doc comment says tax should apply to "the amount the customer pays." Changed `roundCents(cents * taxRate)` to `roundCents(discounted * taxRate)`, which fixed all 3 failures.
